observations: Canonical BASE TypedIR currently establishes deterministic nominal type identity, declaration signatures, type classification and semantic identity.
Function declarations store body_tokens rather than a typed executable expression graph.
The implementation comment explicitly says expressions remain syntax trees until later checker/evaluator semantics consume them.
PR #600 currently accepts a separate bootstrap claycode.typed-ir.v0 expression dictionary with k/num/name/bin/call nodes; that shape is not emitted by the canonical BASE TypedIR builder.

Therefore a direct ClayCodeBaseTypedIR/v1 -> PR600 bytecode adapter cannot currently be proven semantics-preserving without either a new canonical typed-expression lowering stage or bypassing/reconstructing semantics from tokens.

grf.generated_reality: Introduce a canonical executable typed-expression IR stage after BASE declaration TypedIR and type/effect checking, then lower only that admitted stage into the single ClayVM core.
grf.strongest_counter_reality: Treat body_tokens as sufficient compiler input and reparse/reinfer inside the VM compiler. This duplicates frontend/type authority, risks semantic drift, and weakens provenance unless equivalence is explicitly proven.
grf.smallest_discriminator: For one already-supported pure function, produce a canonical typed expression graph with parameter/result TypeRefs and resolved Clay-call targets, then prove deterministic lowering and differential equivalence without consulting raw source/body_tokens in the VM backend.

architecture_delta.required_boundary: typed executable expression IR with resolved call ownership, explicit types/effects, provenance and deterministic identity
architecture_delta.anti_bypass_rule: ClayVM backend must not silently derive missing language semantics from host behavior or raw body token reparsing unless an equivalence contract and tests make that derivation canonical.
architecture_delta.rollback: No production code changed by this receipt; reject this candidate if an already-canonical executable expression IR is found and proven to supersede the observed BASE TypedIR representation.

non_claims: No canonical executable TypedIR implementation is claimed.
No direct adapter is claimed correct.
No whole Clay Machine completion is claimed.
